select config_id, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, create_by, create_time, remark from sys_config
AND config_name like concat('%', #{configName}, '%')
AND config_key like concat('%', #{configKey}, '%')
AND config_type = #{configType}
order by create_time desc
select config_id, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} limit 1
select count(1) from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} limit 1
